To form the complete network we simply merge the resistor dictionaries, giving each resistor a unique identifier (e.g., R1_1 for subnet 1, R1_2 for subnet 2, etc.). Then we combine all connection lists, updating the resistor IDs accordingly. The resulting JSON contains 13 distinct resistors and the full set of connections.</thought>
